item.title: RTDa PNRR: GSD 02/PHYS-03 - SSD PHYS-03/A – Experimental Physics of Matter and Applications – reserved pursuant to Article 2, paragraph 2, letter b) of Ministerial Decree (DM) 193/2026, funded under the PNRR (National Recovery and Resilience Plan). (Univ. TRIESTE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-14 23:59
Institution: Univ. TRIESTE, Trieste
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

item.title: RTT: Public selection for the recruitment of a tenure-track RTT researcher with a fixed-term employment contract pursuant to art. 24, Law 240/2010 (Ref. 2679) (ROMA "Tor Vergata")
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-10 23:59
Institution: ROMA "Tor Vergata", Roma
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-02 Fisica teorica delle interazioni fondamentali, modelli, metodi matematici e applicazioni

The research commitment consists of carrying out research activities in the scientific disciplinary sector covered by the selection procedure, with particular emphasis on Theoretical Physics of Fundamental Interactions, including Gravity. Specific attention will be devoted to extensions of the Standard Model of Elementary Particles and Fundamental Interactions and of General Relativity within the framework of supersymmetric gauge theories, supergravity and string theory, with applications to early-universe physics, black holes and gravitational waves. item.title: RTT: Rif. 6267_All. 3 - Development of high-resolution numerical techniques for applications in micrometeorology and dynamic downscaling (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

Global climate models fail to capture local phenomena due to their coarse spatial resolution—resolution that is nonetheless essential for assessing micro-scale climate change impacts, such as urban heat islands and pollutant dispersion. The research project aims to develop and optimize advanced numerical techniques for dynamic downscaling by integrating fluid dynamics data (LES/DNS) with mesoscale models (WRF). Its novelty lies in the use of advection schemes coupled with machine learning algorithms to reduce computational costs and overcome the limitations of traditional statistical methods by explicitly resolving turbulence. The expected outcome is the provision of predictive models for…

item.title: RTT: Ref. 6286_All. 3 - High Energy Physics with the ATLAS experiment at the Large Hadron Collider (Univ. BOLOGNA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 23:59
Institution: Univ. BOLOGNA, Bologna
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-01 Fisica sperimentale delle interazioni fondamentali e applicazioni

The research project includes participation in experimental activities, data analysis and software development at the ATLAS experiment of the LHC at CERN. The project includes involvement in working groups, with reference to analysis and advanced computing techniques also based on deep learning. Furthermore, technical activities related to the detector are also foreseen, including the subsystems designed for the phase 2 upgrade
